title: Rabbi Valas

paragraphs: Rabbi Hillel son of Rabbi Valas (in Rabbi’s time): Gittin 59a. Rashi on Sanhedrin 36a writes “son of Rabbi Valas,” meaning that one should not read Valus, for it is a gentile name, as in Gittin 11b; Seder HaDorot.[^1]

notes.text: The two supplied forms are וולס, Valas, and ולוס, Valus. The William Davidson digital Gittin 59a gives Rabbi Hillel son of Rabbi Valas; Gittin 11b lists Valus among the non-Jewish names. The distinction between the supplied forms is preserved without inferring a printed-letter history.
